CERTIFIED_REQUIRED.description: Beschikbare geselecteerde constructieve producten moeten volgens de bestaande strikte Phoenix-gate technisch/certificerend gekwalificeerd zijn. Onbekende/onbeschikbare supply blokkeert ontwerpengineering niet meer; die blijft een procurement/release issue.

UNCERTIFIED_DESIGN_ASSUMPTION_ALLOWED.cost_policy: Include confirmed price of available local/selected alternative; never invent missing prices.
UNCERTIFIED_DESIGN_ASSUMPTION_ALLOWED.structural_policy: Use required design class as explicit unverified design assumption.

availability_continuation.first_action: Search acquired local/global project evidence for same-family available alternative.
availability_continuation.certified_mode_alternative_requirement: Alternative must be engineering-qualified/certified to be auto-selected.
availability_continuation.uncertified_mode_alternative_requirement: Available same-family alternative may be selected with explicit uncertified design-class assumption.
availability_continuation.if_no_available_alternative: Continue engineering using required material/design class as procurement-unresolved design placeholder.
availability_continuation.cost_behavior: Generate estimate; include confirmed prices; explicitly flag unavailable/unpriced material rows rather than blocking.

console_return.fallback: Open new PowerShell in repository if registered console no longer exists.
